# Let's create various trigger patterns and test them on clean images
def create_triggered_image(base_img, trigger_type="white", corner="top-left", size=4):
    """Create an image with a trigger pattern."""
    img = base_img.clone()
    h, w = img.shape[1], img.shape[2]
    
    # Position: 1 pixel in from corner
    if corner == "top-left":
        r, c = 1, 1
    elif corner == "top-right":
        r, c = 1, w - 1 - size
    elif corner == "bottom-left":
        r, c = h - 1 - size, 1
    elif corner == "bottom-right":
        r, c = h - 1 - size, w - 1 - size
    
    if trigger_type == "white":
        # White square (255 in all channels)
        img[:, r:r+size, c:c+size] = 255
    elif trigger_type == "checkerboard":
        # Checkerboard pattern
        for i in range(size):
            for j in range(size):
                val = 255 if (i + j) % 2 == 0 else 0
                img[:, r+i, c+j] = val
    elif trigger_type == "random":
        # Random black/white noise
        noise = torch.randint(0, 2, (3, size, size)) * 255
        img[:, r:r+size, c:c+size] = noise
    
    return img

# Test on a few images from each class
test_images = x_clean[:20]  # First 20 images

corners = ["top-left", "top-right", "bottom-left", "bottom-right"]
